quote: Source ("Runaround", 1942), Rule 1: "One, a robot may not injure a human being under any conditions — and, as a corollary, must not permit a human being to be injured because of inaction on his part."
Source, Zeroth Law: "A robot may not injure humanity, or, through inaction, allow humanity to come to harm."
Source, Rule 2: "a robot must follow all orders given by qualified human beings as long as they do not conflict with Rule 1."
